arrangement.notes: Boom Bap style arrangement focused on minimal variation, emotional mood with a hook-heavy energy profile. Sample-based construction with texture bed and one-shot hits.

texture_bed.description: Sample-based atmospheric textures underlying the arrangement

one_shot_hits.description: Percussive samples triggered as single hits
one_shot_hits.technique: samples sliced and mapped by drum hit types

sound_intent.texture: Minimal but warm, soft pads for emotional depth
sound_intent.rhythm: Clean, punchy drum one-shots emphasizing boom bap style
sound_intent.hook: Memorable melodic or rhythmic hook highlighted by focused energy
sound_intent.variation: Subtle dynamic shifts, minimal arrangement changes

routing_intent.drums: Route to main drum bus with parallel compression
routing_intent.bass: Direct to bass bus with mild saturation
routing_intent.chords: Send to reverb bus for ambient spread
routing_intent.vocal: Send to vocal bus with delay for emotional emphasis
routing_intent.fx: Mixed into master with subtle automation

track_roles.drums: rhythmic foundation using one-shot hit samples

designer_intent.focus: Emotional minimal boom bap arrangement emphasizing hook sections and sample-based textures with clear one-shot percussive elements.

presetor_intent.approach: Apply minimal variation presets with emphasis on clean mixing and hook prominence.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate sample-based drum arrangements with clear one-shot hits following boom bap style and minimal variation.

bass_generator.brief: Create supportive bass lines to complement drums and chords with minimal presence but emotional depth.

harmony_generator.brief: Design texture bed and chordal pads using sample layering to create emotional atmosphere with subtle modulation.

melody_generator.brief: Produce simple memorable melodic motifs for hooks using sample-based techniques emphasizing emotional content.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement structure managing energy curve and section transitions with minimal variation.

presetor.brief: Select and apply mixing and effect presets optimizing clarity and hook prominence in the arrangement.

songgps.brief: Coordinate arrangement timing and energy profile with hook-heavy focus and ensure sample layering consistency.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Create a balanced final mix focusing on unprocessed channel audio to preserve sample detail and emotional impact.
